summary: Oceanhawk Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K reporting that on September 30, 2026 it issued an unsecured promissory note in the principal amount of $1,550,000 to its sponsor, Oceanhawk Acquisition I Sponsor, LLC. The note bears no interest and is repayable in full upon consummation of the company's initial business combination; absent a deal, repayment comes from funds outside the IPO trust account. Customary events of default accelerate the balance. Issued under Section 4(a)(2) exemption. This is routine SPAC sponsor working-capital financing, not a special situation; watch for a business combination announcement and any further extension notes.
